summary: Rationale-only status update, validated as no_change with no effects, recording the final state without creating or duplicating records. Both investigations stand complete and coherent: configuration recovery (98ee8dfd5fac4b84915f91ed4b094bcf-question-0) on seven receipts - single-voter recovery with flag-off controls, the three-voter commit-rule witness reproduced four times, the durable-snapshot corruption surviving a flag-off restart, the authority pair with its premise-failure repeat and premise-enforcing revision, and the two-voter probe bounding the claim to candidacy rather than participation; and replay completion (29e4214f5ee146b393957fa23a33a73d-question-0) on eleven receipts - the block pair, the measured bound pair, the availability consequence at two batch sizes, the exact 128-delivered-batch boundary at two batch sizes, and default-configuration reachability reproduced twice. Both conclusions remain violated with the defects asserted, 54 claims across 14 retained receipts were verified against the observations with no discrepancy, both knowledge corrections raised by this evidence are recorded with affected uses marked and gaps answered, and the last change repaired the one internal contradiction that remained. Remaining limits are structural (in-memory transports and stores in one process, no production store, no process-level restart or disk fault, one prefix shape per scenario, and the snapshot-shipping propagation path unexercised); with the allocation nearly exhausted no uncitable probe is started, and expiry preserves this state.
